remarks: Bright, well-maintained studio in Stamford's Hyde Park building. Perfect for commuter with easy access to Springdale train station and Merritt Parkway. Located just minutes from Springdale shopping, restaurants, and Twin Rinks. No pets allowed. Rent includes heat, hot water and reserved secure underground parking. Complex offers a gym conveniently located in the building as well as laundry on every floor.
